name: Xperia PRO

Launch.Announced / released: 2021-01-27 (Japan and United States), 2021-06-13 (United Kingdom), 2021-06-14 (Germany and Nordic countries)

Body.Other: IP65/IP68 Water/dust resistant, Dynamic Vibration System

Platform.Operating system: Android 10, upgradable to Android 12, 2 OS updates, 2 years of security patches
Platform.CPU: Octa-core (1x 2.84 GHz Gold Prime, 3x 2.42 GHz Gold, 4x 1.8 GHz Silver) Kryo 585

Display.Display: 6.5 in 4K 21:9 (3840 x 1644) HDR OLED CinemaWide™ display, ~643 ppi, Gorilla Glass 6, HDR10, HLG, 10-bit color depth

Cameras.Rear camera: 12.2 MP (Sony Exmor RS IMX557), f/1.7, 24mm (wide), 1/1.7", 1.8 μm, predictive Dual Pixel PDAF, 5-axis OIS, 12.2 MP (Samsung ISOCELL S5K3T2), f/2.4, 70mm (telephoto), 1/3.4", 1.0 μm, predictive Dual Pixel PDAF, 3x optical zoom, 5-axis OIS, 12.2 MP (Sony Exmor RS IMX363), f/2.2, 16mm (ultra-wide), 1/2.55", predictive Dual Pixel PDAF, 3D iToF sensor, Zeiss optics, HDR, eye tracking, 4K@24/25/30/60/120fps, 1080p@30/60/120fps
Cameras.Front camera: 8 MP (Samsung ISOCELL S5K4H7), f/2.0, 24mm (wide), 1/4", 1.0 μm, 5-axis gyro-EIS, HDR, 1080p@30fps

Sound.Sound: Front-facing stereo speakers, 3.5 mm headphone jack, 24-bit/192kHz audio

Battery.Charging: USB Power Delivery (USB-PD) 3.0 21 W Fast Charging

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/6 (2.4/5GHz), Bluetooth 5.1, USB-C 3.1 (supports DisplayPort), Micro-HDMI, NFC, GPS with Assisted GPS, Galileo, GLONASS
